svg.title: Data acquisition procedure and data preprocessing steps
svg.desc: Complete editable SVG reconstruction. Base frame f01 contains panel A: task/cognitive-load table at left, seated participant icon at center, radar device and beam, and panel label. Base frame f02 contains panel B: thermal/RGB/NIR camera inputs, raw frame thumbnails, processing arrows, yellow processing boxes, face crop thumbnails, downsampled output thumbnails, IQ chirp preprocessing, range matrix construction, and panel label. No SAM assets were supplied, so all thumbnails/icons are constructed in native SVG.
